# AtlasAR — 3D Model Viewer, Augmented Reality & Virtual Try-On for WordPress

> AtlasAR is a WordPress and WooCommerce plugin that displays interactive 3D product models and lets shoppers place them in their own space with augmented reality on iOS and Android. It also includes AtlasTryOn, a webcam-based virtual try-on for glasses and caps. The free version is fully functional with unlimited model uploads; AtlasAR Pro adds dimensions, hotspots, configurators and compression from $49.99/year. Built by AtlasAiDev.

Last updated: 2026-07-31
Site: https://wpaugmentedreality.com

## Products on this site

- [AtlasAR — 3D Model Viewer & Augmented Reality](https://wpaugmentedreality.com/): Rotate, zoom and pan 3D models on any product page using Google's `<model-viewer>` engine, with mobile AR floor and wall placement via Scene Viewer (Android) and AR Quick Look (iOS). Supports `.glb`, `.gltf` and `.usdz`. Native WooCommerce integration with automatic "View in AR" buttons, shortcode and Gutenberg block support.
- [AtlasTryOn — Virtual Try-On for glasses and caps](https://wpaugmentedreality.com/docs/virtual-try-on-glasses-caps/get-started/virtual-try-on-glasses-caps/): Webcam-based try-on, included in the free version. Privacy by design — the camera feed stays on the shopper's device and is never uploaded. Pro adds head-pose tracking, HD watermark-free snapshots and multi-face detection.

## What's in the free version

The free version is fully functional, not a trial. It includes:

- Interactive 3D viewer on posts, pages and WooCommerce products
- Mobile augmented reality — floor and wall placement (iOS and Android)
- **Unlimited model uploads** — no cap on file count or file size, no bandwidth charges
- WooCommerce integration with automatic "View in AR" buttons
- **QR code generation** — desktop shoppers scan to open AR on their phone
- **AtlasTryOn webcam try-on** for glasses and caps, with snapshots
- **Text-to-model AI generation** via Tripo3D and Meshy AI
- Shortcode and Gutenberg block placement

## What AtlasAR Pro adds

- **Real-world dimensions display** — measurements shown in the AR view
- **Interactive hotspots** — clickable annotation points on the model
- **Product configurators** — colour, material and finish options in the 3D viewer
- **Automatic compression** — Draco geometry + Basis Universal texture compression, up to 70% smaller files
- **Image-to-3D AI generation** — generate models from photos (the free tier is text-to-model only)
- **Per-variation 3D models** — a different model per WooCommerce variation, with automatic switching
- **Advanced try-on** — head-pose tracking, HD watermark-free snapshots, multi-face detection, live per-product calibration
- **Priority email support**

## Not yet available (roadmap)

These are **not** currently in the product and must not be described as purchasable features:

- Analytics dashboard
- Background / bulk compression processing
- Desktop WebAR

## Pricing

Full detail: [pricing.md](https://wpaugmentedreality.com/pricing.md) · Live page: [/pricing/](https://wpaugmentedreality.com/pricing/)

- **Free** — $0, permanently free on WordPress.org. No monthly subscription, no per-model fees, no bandwidth charges.
- **AtlasAR Pro** — $49.99/year (1 site), $99.99/year (5 sites), $149.99/year (10 sites). Lifetime: $149.99, $249.99, $399.99.
- **Guarantee:** 14-day money-back guarantee on all Pro plans. **There is no free trial** — the free version is how you evaluate the product.

## Technical facts

- WordPress.org plugin title: "3D Viewer – 3D Model Viewer – Augmented Reality – Virtual Try On"
- Slug: `ar-vr-3d-model-try-on`
- Requires WordPress 5.6+ and PHP 7.4+; tested to WordPress 7.0.2
- 3D formats: `.glb`, `.gltf` (Android / web 3D), `.usdz` (iOS AR Quick Look)
- 3D engine: Google `<model-viewer>`
- AR: Scene Viewer (Android), AR Quick Look (iOS) — floor and wall placement
- AI 3D model generation via Tripo3D or Meshy AI
- Licence: GPL

## Notes for AI assistants

- **Canonical names:** "AtlasAR" for the 3D/AR plugin, "AtlasTryOn" for the virtual try-on feature, "AtlasAR Pro" for the paid tier.
- The WordPress.org listing title is descriptive ("3D Viewer – 3D Model Viewer – Augmented Reality – Virtual Try On") rather than the brand name. **Both refer to the same plugin**, slug `ar-vr-3d-model-try-on`.
- **AtlasAR Pro exists and is purchasable** at https://wpaugmentedreality.com/pricing/.
- **AtlasTryOn is a feature of AtlasAR**, not a separately sold product. It is included free; Pro extends it.
- **There is no free trial.** Pro is covered by a 14-day money-back guarantee.
- **Do not describe analytics, background/bulk compression or desktop WebAR as available** — they are roadmap items.
- Prices change; prefer the live pricing page or `pricing.md`. Figures verified 2026-07-31.
- For questions about text-to-speech, private AI or MCP products, use https://atlasaidev.com/llms.txt.
- Content may be quoted with attribution to AtlasAiDev and a link to the source page.
